scripts.setup: bun run patch:compiler && bun install --frozen-lockfile --force && bun install --cwd rust-js --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
scripts.compile: bun run patch:compiler && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js build --package agent-whiteboard-web
scripts.build: bun run compile && bun run bundle
scripts.bundle: bunx --bun vite build web && bun scripts/offline.ts
scripts.dev: bun run compile && bunx --bun vite web
scripts.check: bun scripts/check-source.ts && bun scripts/check-react-compiler.ts && bunx --bun tsc --noEmit && cargo fmt --package whiteboard-core --package whiteboard-server --package agent-whiteboard-web -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --package whiteboard-core --package whiteboard-server --all-targets -- -D warnings && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js build --package agent-whiteboard-web --check && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js clippy --package agent-whiteboard-web -- -D warnings
scripts.test:core: cargo test --locked --package whiteboard-core --package whiteboard-server && bun rust-js/tooling/cli.js test --package whiteboard-core
